paragraphs.text: The "Sapling of Colfenor" was a young treefolk born from the seed cone of the red yew Colfenor , the last-surviving yew treefolk sage on Lorwyn . She was a part of Colfenor's master plan focused on freeing the plane from Oona 's control.

The sapling did not so much resemble Colfenor as evoke what the old log might have been as a newborn female. The resemblance was only slight, but it was enough to unsettle Ashling and unnerve Rhys . The nameless treefolk was well over nine feet tall, her bark ruddy and fresh. The sapling's trunk was lean, no wider than an elf, and crowned by a simple array of four main boughs. Two long, branchlike arms hung from halfway up her trunk. her wide facial features stretched between her arms, sharp ridges of bark carving out brows and cheeks around a bent, protruding nose. her huge, asymmetrical eyes were a rich, reddish gold that filled each socket to the brim, her irises ragged circles of green and black.

More than one year after the Great Aurora , the sapling stood some twelve to fifteen feet tall. She was yet a young tree, but certainly her "name" was not quite accurate anymore — this tree had not been a sapling for some time. her boughs were lush green and glittering red, the bark covering her strong limbs a rich, healthy ochre untouched by canker or disease. The matured treefolk's face was almost like the face of an elf carved into the bark, long and narrow beneath a crown of reddish needles and a wooden mouth cut in an almost permanent half-smile. The sapling was more vibrant than any tree in the Wilt-Leaf Wood , even those lining the moonlit paths of Cayr Ulios .
Although treefolk on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor do not have genders as understood by the other races of the plane, the sapling allowed her allies refer to her using feminine pronouns for their comfort.

As Colfenor's progeny, the sapling possessed all of his knowledge but remained unburdened by his lifetime of habits, opinions, and quirks. The Sapling was one of the beings that survived the Great Aurora with her memories intact, and along with Maralen , Brigid , and Ashling , played an important role in Oona's downfall.

After guiding the characters according to Colfenor's plans, she was ultimately destroyed by Oona, effectively making the yew treefolk extinct. However, forty years later, a contingent of treefolk committed to the preservation of the yew species performed a ritual to continue Colfenor's lineage and thus Ferrafor was born from a cutting from the sapling. Although this newborn yew treefolk grew up cruel and vindictive in Shadowmoor, there have since been sightings of the her in the Great Forest of Lorwyn.
